lines.en: label utasummer2maidgen:
scene utasummer2maidgen
Once again, I subject myself to the financial Hell that is the maid cafe while Uta is working.
lines.zh: 我又一次把自己送进了那个财务地狱——趁着 Uta 上班的时候去了女仆咖啡厅。

lines.en: Thankfully, I think she’s beginning to feel bad for me after how much money I have spent on her, as I’ve noticed an increasing amount of complimentary items and discounts as of late.
lines.zh: 所幸，看在我为她花了那么多钱的份上，我想她开始有点过意不去了，因为我注意到最近免费的东西和折扣越来越多了。

lines.en: She doesn’t even charge extra for the flavor beam anymore, and I think that might actually be the best part of all.
lines.zh: 她现在连味道棒都不额外收费了，而我觉得那大概是所有事情里最好的一点。

lines.en: There are people who would kill for this if they had to.
lines.zh: 如果非得如此，有人会为这个杀人。

lines.en: I am one of them.
The good thing, though, is that this is a power that can only be harnessed by one person...and that even though there are other maids who work here, none of them are ready for it yet.
lines.zh: 不过好消息是，这种力量只有一个人能驾驭……而且虽然这里还有别的女仆在干活，她们都还没准备好。

lines.en: Which...is good. Because if Ami gained this power and began using it at home, I wouldn’t have a reason to leave the house anymore.
lines.zh: 这……是好事。因为如果 Ami 获得了这种力量，开始在家里用它，那我就再也没有理由出门了。

lines.en: I couldn’t possibly do that to Uta-chan.
lines.zh: 我绝不可能对 Uta 酱做出那种事。

lines.en: If I ever made her sad, I would have to kill myself.
lines.zh: 如果我有朝一日让她伤心了，我就只能自杀了。

lines.en: scene black
Uta-chan disappears into the back room and I wonder for a moment about why life is so unfair and why she can’t just stay in maid form for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: Uta 酱消失进了后面的房间，我有一瞬间在想，人生为什么这么不公平，她为什么不能永远保持女仆形态。

lines.en: I’m sure that if I asked her, she’d respond with something along the lines of how Uta-chan is only special because she exists only when she needs to.
lines.zh: 我敢说如果我问她，她大概会回答类似这样的话：Uta 酱之所以特别，正因为她只在需要的时候才存在。

lines.en: But what she doesn’t understand is that I need her to exist at all times if I am ever going to understand my place in this world.
lines.zh: 可她不明白的是，如果我还想搞懂自己在这个世界上的位置，我就需要她时时刻刻都存在。

lines.en: Uta-chan is the key to everything.
Uta-chan is the light that guides me home.
lines.zh: Uta 酱是引我回家的光。

lines.en: And I will make her mine, whether she wants to be or not.
lines.zh: 而我会让她成为我的，不管她愿不愿意。
